name: m3-queue-offline-light
steps: const h=window.__sim.host;if(h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===window.__m3Writer).state!=='interrupted')throw Error('Writer did not stop'); if(h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===window.__m3Desktop).state==='interrupted')throw Error('Stopped the desktop task instead')

if(!document.querySelector('.app__safety')?.textContent.includes('Last known:')) throw Error('Missing stale ownership'); if(!document.querySelector('.app__safety')?.textContent.includes('Pause and Stop need a connection')) throw Error('Missing reachability note')
